settings.forced_root_action: fixed for every simulation; vanilla PUCT below root

metric_conventions.distance_delta: after minus before; positive means that player's shortest path became longer
metric_conventions.child_value_head_root_perspective: negative of child value because the opponent is to move after the root action
metric_conventions.forced_root_search_Q: root player's perspective, backed up through the existing MCTS sign-flip logic
metric_conventions.prevents_immediate_opponent_win: opponent had a legal one-action winning pawn move before the root action and has none after it
metric_conventions.delays_opponent_threat: root was an opponent-distance<=2 threat position and the action increases opponent shortest-path distance
